title: The delayed IPO of Visma, an accounting software company valued at €19B, amid SaaSpocalypse fears, is a major setback for PE parent Hg, a software buyout giant (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: The delayed IPO of Visma, an accounting software company valued at €19B, amid SaaSpocalypse fears, is a major setback for PE parent Hg, a software buyout giant — Delayed IPO of €19bn software group Visma was meant to be a crowning moment for PE group Hg — and London
